verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax automates filing only for US sales tax, and only through a TaxJar integration, so filing is not native or worldwide. Community posts confirm the TaxJar route for US filing and suggest UK/EU remittance remains a manual hassle, with merchants otherwise filing and paying themselves. Missing for 10: native automated filing and remittance outside the US (VAT/GST in all registered jurisdictions), evidence that remittance itself is automated, any vendor guarantee covering late-filing penalties, and independent corroboration of on-time filing.
